caption: The drawing displays a rectangular chest with ornate decorative elements, primarily in shades of teal, brown, red, green, and gold. The main body of the chest is teal with intricate symmetrical folk art designs, including two large stylized flower motifs with red and gold petals, connected by orange arches supported on red columns. On either side of each flower motif is a stylized bird, rendered in dark blue and brown with white spots. Smaller red floral decorations are dotted around the main designs. The center of the chest's front features a shield-like pattern surrounded by a circular motif, split by the numbers "18" and "94" on either side, suggesting a year. The chest stands on a carved wooden base colored brown with three front drawers, each drawer featuring elaborate patterns and brass handles. The chest's lid has a border and features a continuation of the folk art theme, as shown in a smaller rectangle inset on the upper right of the image; this inset reveals additional details with two birds facing each other among more stylized flowers, maintaining the teal and red color scheme. The artist’s name, "BETTY JEAN DAVIS," is printed in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Pa. German Chest
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
